jobs.title: VP, Field Engineering - Midwest Region
jobs.description:
This role requires the ability to work lawfully in the U.S. without employment-based immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.

About Charter

Charter Communications, Inc. (NASDAQ: CHTR) is the leading broadband and video company in the nation and the fastest growing mobile provider in its footprint, with services available to more than 70 million homes and small to large businesses across 45 states through its Spectrum brand. Founded in 1993, Charter has evolved from providing cable TV to streaming, and from high-speed Internet to a converged broadband, WiFi and mobile experience. Over the Spectrum Fiber Broadband Network and supported by our 100% U.S.-based employees, the Company offers Seamless Connectivity and Entertainment with Spectrum Internet®, Mobile, TV, and Voice products.

More information can be found at corporate.charter.com

Spectrum’s Field Operations business unit

Our Field Operations team is responsible for building, upgrading, maintaining and connecting customers to our advanced, always on, fiber powered network.

Vice President Field Engineering – Midwest Region

(Note: this position is based in Blue Ash with frequent travel throughout Ohio, Kentucky, Indiana, and western West Virginia)

The Vice President Field Engineering is responsible for ensuring the reliability of Spectrum's fiber broadband access network. The VP directs regional efforts for network upgrades, preventative maintenance, repairs, outage reduction and other efforts to meet Spectrum's customer commitments for reliable connectivity.

Implements and enhances consistent practices to ensure network health throughout the Region
Oversees Regional programs for demand and scheduled maintenance
Responsible for Regional adherence with company network engineering design standards including amplifier cascades, bandwidth migration and management
Works with Inside Plant (ISP) team on network upgrades, hub collapses, outages and other projects and initiatives requiring coordination between ISP and outside plant
Consults with Corporate Field Engineering and Network Technology Services (NTS) on strategic planning of rebuilds and system extensions and upgrades
Plans needs for third party resources for plant upgrades and repair
Represents the Region in operational reviews in connection with all Regional engineering initiatives
Responsible for Regional compliance with Federal Communications Commission and other federal and state regulatory network requirements
Oversees Regional disaster recovery efforts.

What You’ll Bring To Spectrum

Experience: Experience working and leading the field construction/engineering and/or network and maintenance functions in the cable/communication business (10+years), management of annual budget preparation and implementation (8 years), senior level management experience (10+years)
Education: Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field, or equivalent field experience; SCTE/BCTE certification or equivalent field experience
Industry and vendor specific certifications and training Advanced Knowledge of HFC, Advanced Video, and IP Networks
Knowledge of all FCC compliance reports and other rules and regulations, a comprehensive understanding of applicable local and state rules and regulations; Comprehensive understanding of OSHA rules and regulations, both federal and state; Comprehensive understanding of HVAC and power distribution systems; Advanced knowledge of Digital Transmission; Advanced knowledge of Electronic theory Advanced knowledge of Federal Communications Commission regulations; Advanced knowledge of Fiber Optic theory; Knowledge of National Electric Code and National Electric Safety Code

SPECTRUM CONNECTS YOU TO MORE

Learning Culture and Dynamic Growth: We invest in your learning, offering training, hands-on experience, and mentoring to advance your skills
Competitive Pay/Total Rewards: We believe our people are our greatest asset. That is why we're proud to provide our employees with some of the best benefits in the industry; See all the ways we invest in you—at work and in life

Apply now, connect a friend to this opportunity or sign up for job alerts

XEN116 2026-82478 XEN116 2026

Here, our employees don’t just have jobs, they're building careers. That’s why we offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package that rewards employees for their contributions to our success, supporting all aspects of their well-being at every stage of life.

A qualified applicant’s criminal history, if any, will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable laws, including local ordinances.

The base pay for this position generally is between $158,500.00 and $263,900.00
. The actual compensation offered will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. We comply with local wage minimums and also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of other incentive-based compensation such as bonuses.

Get to Know Us
Charter Communications provides superior communication and entertainment products for residential and business customers through the Spectrum brand. Our offerings include Spectrum Internet®, TV, Mobile and Voice. Beyond our connectivity solutions, we also provide local news, programming and regional sports via Spectrum Networks and multiscreen advertising solutions via Spectrum Reach. When you join our team, you’ll be keeping our customers connected to what matters most in 41 states across the U.S. Watch this video to learn more.

Grow Your Career Here
We’re committed to growing a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve – providing opportunities for employment and advancement to all team members. Spectrum is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including job seekers with disabilities and veterans. Learn about Life at Spectrum.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Cloud Product Experience
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager
to lead the team building the product experience for Aerospike Cloud
—our multi-cloud, fully managed database service.
This team owns the surfaces and systems customers use to interact with the cloud: the console and APIs, billing and licensing, usage and telemetry, and the workflows that make Aerospike Cloud intuitive and easy to operate
.
You’ll lead, hire, and grow a team of frontend and full-stack engineers while owning the technical direction and execution of these product areas. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of product and infrastructure
and staying close to architecture, product decisions, and production execution.
Bay Area–based team members work from the office three days per week, typically Tuesday through Thursday.

What You’ll Do

Own the Cloud product experience.
Lead engineering for the console, APIs, and workflows customers use to provision, manage, and understand Aerospike Cloud.
Lead and grow the team.
Hire, coach, and develop frontend and full-stack engineers while building a strong culture of ownership and execution.
Build the systems behind the experience.
Own capabilities spanning usage metering, billing, licensing and entitlements, and customer-facing telemetry.
Set the technical direction.
Stay close to architecture and code, make pragmatic technology choices, and maintain a high engineering bar across frontend, APIs, and services.
Make the Cloud observable.
Give customers clear visibility into database health, performance, usage, and cost.
Ship across boundaries.
Partner closely with Product, Design, Finance, and Control Plane teams to turn complex infrastructure capabilities into simple product experiences.
Own what you ship.
Establish reliability and product metrics and ensure the team’s services operate well in production.

What We’re Looking For

7+ years
of software engineering experience, including 3+ years managing engineering teams
.
Proven experience hiring, coaching, and developing engineers
and building high-performing teams.
Strong technical background in frontend or full-stack engineering, ideally with React, TypeScript, APIs, and cloud-native services
.
Experience leading teams building customer-facing SaaS, developer platforms, cloud consoles, or infrastructure products
.
Demonstrated ability to stay close to architecture and technical decisions
while giving engineers clear ownership.
Strong product instincts and experience partnering closely with Product and Design
.
Experience working across organizational boundaries and translating complex business and technical requirements into an executable roadmap.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
and modern cloud-native environments.
Experience operating production systems
where reliability, correctness, and operational ownership matter.

Nice to Have

Experience building a developer console, admin portal, or control plane for a database, cloud, or infrastructure product.
Experience with billing, usage metering, licensing, or entitlements
.
Experience building customer-facing metrics, telemetry, or observability
experiences.
Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana
.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Go, Node.js, or Temporal
.
Familiarity with distributed systems or high-scale databases.

Salary Range
: $250,000 – $310,000
(Actual compensation will be based on experience, location, and other relevant factors.)

Aerospike is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
We are committed to an environment free from discrimination based on race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

About the Wireless Communication Company / The Opportunity:

Join a forward-thinking organization in the wireless communication industry, where innovative technology and data-driven solutions support critical customer and business operations. As Vice President & Head of CRM Technology, you will shape the strategy, architecture, and development of a strategic Salesforce CRM ecosystem while leading integration, data, and application initiatives across cloud and on-premise environments. This high-impact leadership opportunity combines hands-on technical influence with team development and close partnership with senior business stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

Own the strategic roadmap and technology vision for the CRM ecosystem, aligning technical execution with business priorities.
Direct the architecture, development, implementation, and delivery of CRM integration solutions across internal and external platforms.
Lead, mentor, and manage CRM developers while establishing standards for architecture, code quality, documentation, and delivery.
Serve as the primary technical stakeholder and escalation point for CRM initiatives across technology and business teams.
Design and build service-based solutions using Azure App Services, Azure SQL Database, Microsoft Fabric, and related cloud technologies.
Guide Salesforce platform enhancements and ensure effective release management, environment governance, and CI/CD practices.
Partner with business users to define requirements, prioritize work, resolve application issues, and address data discrepancies.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to senior stakeholders and promote sustainable, user-focused business solutions.

Must-Have Skills:

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or a related field.
10+ years of experience in CRM or data application development, including deep hands-on expertise with C#, Python, .NET Core, and SQL Server.
Experience defining technology strategy and priorities with senior business stakeholders.
Proven experience leading or mentoring development teams with accountability for technical direction and delivery.
Strong SQL expertise, including advanced querying, window functions, CTEs, pivoting, and slowly changing dimensions.
Strong knowledge of ETL tools, data integration patterns, and application lifecycle management.
Experience designing and reviewing Salesforce integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, Bulk API, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture.
Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Flow/Process Automation sufficient to guide and review development work.
Experience with Salesforce data governance, including sharing and security models, field-level security, data quality, and deduplication strategies.
Familiarity with Salesforce release management and DevOps practices, including sandboxes, change sets, and CI/CD.
Excellent written and verbal communication, customer service, prioritization, vendor management, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Understanding of portfolio management processes, including Positions and Transactions, and their relationship to CRM objects such as Accounts, Contacts, and Opportunities.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

Experience with microservices and service-oriented architecture.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure DataBricks, Snowflake, or comparable data platforms.
Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD implementation.
Relevant Salesforce certifications or Salesforce administration experience.
Recent experience in asset management, investment management, or hedge fund environments.
Knowledge of master data management concepts and enterprise data governance.
Experience with Python and data manipulation libraries.
Experience using job scheduling platforms such as JAMS, ActiveBatch, AutoSys, or equivalent tools.
Strong technical writing and documentation skills.

jobs.title: Senior Java Software Engineer - Vice President
jobs.description:
In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities. This is a Senior Software Engineering position at the Vice President level, which is part of the job family responsible for developing and maintaining software solutions that support business needs.

About The Role

We're hiring a senior hands on engineer for the Morgan Stanley Equity Swaps technology team — the platform behind a market-leading, global front-office business. You'll be working hands-on inside a large-scale, real-time, event-driven system that processes significant volume every day, alongside a team actively modernizing the platform rather than just maintaining it.

This isn't a role where seniority means stepping away from code. You'll be designing, architecting, and building core components yourself, while also shaping technical direction and mentoring less experienced engineers on the team. Expect real ownership: you'll be trusted to make architectural calls, not just implement someone else's spec.

What You'll Do In The Role

Building and evolving a multi-threaded, Linux-based, real-time Java platform handling high-throughput event flows
Driving analysis, design, and architecture for complex, cross-team initiatives
Working with an interesting tech stack: RDBMS alongside technologies like MongoDB, Kafka, IBM MQ, Hazelcast, and Snowflake
Getting deeply hands-on with our large sharded MongoDB cluster, with the expectation of growing into one of the team's go-to subject matter expert on its design, performance, and operational behaviour
Becoming a technical expert on our core cashflow calculator — not just the code, but the underlying numbers, so you can reason confidently about whether outputs are actually correct, not just whether the system ran without error
Strengthening our test automation and deployment practices — we're steadily maturing toward greater CI/CD and are looking for engineers who want to help drive that evolution, rather than someone joining a fully-automated pipeline
Participating in L3 support for North America on a fair rotation — as a senior engineer, you'll be relied on to lead the hard incidents and ambiguous problems
Actively using AI tooling (Claude, Amp, Deep Search, and others) to accelerate the SDLC — we want engineers who are evolving their own workflow with AI while keeping strong technical judgment and oversight over what ships

What You'll Bring To The Role

10+ years of experience
Java, server-side, concurrent/multi-threaded programming, with Spring Boot (Core Spring) and JUnit
Solid understanding of message-based architectures (Kafka and/or IBM MQ)
Strong RDBMS skills — Sybase and/or DB2 preferred — with proficiency writing complex SQL
Unix/Linux scripting (Shell / Python)
Sharp problem-solving and analytical ability, with a track record of owning full SDLC delivery
Excellent written and verbal communication — you'll be expected to explain complex tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders
Genuine interest in learning the business the platform supports, not just the tech

Desired Skills

Experience operating or tuning large-scale sharded MongoDB clusters
Comfort with financial calculations and a willingness to get into the weeds of numerical correctness, not just code correctness
Knowledge of the Equity Derivatives business
Experience integrating AI-assisted development tools into a real engineering workflow

Who Thrives Here

Strong technical instincts and happy owning ambiguous, complex problems end-to-end
Someone who wants technical leadership without giving up hands-on coding
A collaborator who can push back constructively with demanding stakeholders and hold a clear technical position
Genuine curiosity about the Equity Derivatives business itself, not just the codebase
A "can-do," solutions-first attitude when architectural tradeoffs get contentious

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Expected base pay rates for the role will be between $155,000 and $215,000 per year at the commencement of employment. However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long-term incentive packages, and other Morgan Stanley sponsored benefit programs.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

Driving analysis, design, and architecture for complex, cross-team initiatives
Working with an interesting tech stack: RDBMS alongside technologies like MongoDB, Kafka, IBM MQ, Hazelcast, and Snowflake
Getting deeply hands-on with our large sharded MongoDB cluster, with the expectation of growing into one of the team's go-to subject matter expert on its design, performance, and operational behaviour
Becoming a technical expert on our core cashflow calculator — not just the code, but the underlying numbers, so you can reason confidently about whether outputs are actually correct, not just whether the system ran without error
Strengthening our test automation and deployment practices — we're steadily maturing toward greater CI/CD and are looking for engineers who want to help drive that evolution, rather than someone joining a fully-automated pipeline
Participating in L3 support for North America on a fair rotation — as a senior engineer, you'll be relied on to lead the hard incidents and ambiguous problems
Actively using AI tooling (Claude, Amp, Deep Search, and others) to accelerate the SDLC — we want engineers who are evolving their own workflow with AI while keeping strong technical judgment and oversight over what ships

What You'll Bring To The Role

10+ years of experience
Java, server-side, concurrent/multi-threaded programming, with Spring Boot (Core Spring) and JUnit
Solid understanding of message-based architectures (Kafka and/or IBM MQ)
Strong RDBMS skills — Sybase and/or DB2 preferred — with proficiency writing complex SQL
Unix/Linux scripting (Shell / Python)
Sharp problem-solving and analytical ability, with a track record of owning full SDLC delivery
Excellent written and verbal communication — you'll be expected to explain complex tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders
Genuine interest in learning the business the platform supports, not just the tech

Desired Skills

Experience operating or tuning large-scale sharded MongoDB clusters
Comfort with financial calculations and a willingness to get into the weeds of numerical correctness, not just code correctness
Knowledge of the Equity Derivatives business
Experience integrating AI-assisted development tools into a real engineering workflow

Who Thrives Here

Strong technical instincts and happy owning ambiguous, complex problems end-to-end
Someone who wants technical leadership without giving up hands-on coding
A collaborator who can push back constructively with demanding stakeholders and hold a clear technical position
Genuine curiosity about the Equity Derivatives business itself, not just the codebase
A "can-do," solutions-first attitude when architectural tradeoffs get contentious
